test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper earns 10% on an investment but loses 20% on another investment. If the ratio of the two investments is 2 ∶ 3, then the combined loss percentage is :
solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper earns 10% on an investment but loses 20% on another investment. 

The ratio of the two investments is 2 ∶ 3.

Concept used:

Weighted average, W = frac {sum^nᵢ ₌ ₁ X_iW_i}{sum^nᵢ ₌ ₁ W_i}

W = weighted average

n = number of terms to be averaged

Wᵢ = weights applied to x values

Xᵢ = data values to be averaged

Calculation:

His combined loss percentage

⇒ frac {10 times 2 - 20 times 3}{2 + 3}(Loss is taken in a negative manner in contrast to the profit)

⇒ -8% (Negative sign indicates loss)

**∴ The combined loss percentage is 8%.**
